summary.text: Joanna King is a Republican member of the Indiana House of Representatives who represents District 49, assumed office on December 21, 2020, and is the incumbent in the November 3, 2026 general election for that seat.
Ballotpedia lists Michelle Milne (D) as the other candidate on the general election ballot.

paragraphs.text: Joanna King lives in Middlebury, Indiana, graduated from Northridge High School, and co-owns King Corporation.
King succeeded Christy Stutzman (R) in District 49.
For 2025-2026, Ballotpedia lists her on the Courts and Criminal Code, Government and Regulatory Reform, and Public Health committees.
